titulo: Moscow accuses Estonia of acting ‘on verge of unleashing open war with Russia’ – Europe live
cuerpo: Estonia has continued to deny it has allowed Ukrainian drones to operate from its territory despite repeated unsubstantiated claims from the Kremlin Turning to Ukraine, Nato’s Rutte stresses the need to secure the flow of “crucial supplies” or air defence weapons and ammunition to Ukraine. “ It helps Ukraine to defend itself today, but it also strengthens Ukraine’s hands in any future negotiations with Russia. … But support needs to be concrete. We have to show Putin that his attempts to weaken our support will fail.” “Our citizens need to know that the lights will stay on, that their homes will stay warm, that hospitals, transport and communications will keep working.” “One day it can be in the form of an arson attack against a factory or drones disrupt disrupting an airport.
